top10.name: dshmarket
top10.description: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。

top10.name: dsh-pocket
top10.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。

top10.name: @liustack/modsearch
top10.description: Plug-in web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access, powered by the free Antigravity CLI

top10.name: dsh-builtin-browser
top10.description: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness: install-and-use — a visible native browser the human can take over, driven by the agent over CDP. DOM-level interaction (React/Vue safe), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence (browser_auth), CAPTC

top10.name: dsh-deepread
top10.description: AI deep-reading assistant: extract core claims, argument structure, and key evidence from books and articles. Five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book); knowledge-map reports include confidence levels, data facts, relation labels, Mermai

top10.name: dsh-win32
top10.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 插件：沙箱内唯一能跑的持久 shell、可用的极简模式、前台命令识别、旧编码读取与安装体检 | First-class Windows for DSH

top10.name: dsh-mnemon
top10.description: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar

top10.name: @dttxorg/deepseekeyes
top10.description: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness with source-preserving evidence.

top10.name: dsh-better-edit
top10.description: Hash-anchored read/edit/batch_edit/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line gets a unique 3-char hash (A-Za-z0-9) that stays stable across edits; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected, never fuzzy-matched. Undo persists across restart

top10.name: pi2dsh
top10.description: Bridge the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems: a general Pi Host ABI that runs unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins, plus per-package conversion and MCP config translation.
